product_summary: Industrial (oil & gas / petrochemical / power / LNG) valves: ball valves (floating, trunnion mounted, top entry, cryogenic, metal-seated), gate valves (bolted bonnet, pressure seal, cryogenic), globe valves (bolted cover, pressure seal, cryogenic), check valves (swing, dual plate, lift, piston, cryogenic) and triple offset butterfly valves. Standards cited on site: API 6D, API 608, API 594, API 598, API 6FA/607, BS 1868, BS 6364, ASME B16.34, B16.5, B16.25. Source: oswalvalves.com homepage, /ball-valve, /check-valve (read 2026).
comment: HS mapping: 848130 (check valves) is corroborated by the product line - exact. 848180 covers ball/gate/globe/butterfly valves - correct at HS-6, but the declaration is under-specified: butterfly valves (848180) and cryogenic variants are not separately reflected, and no HS line exists for the foundry/casting output the site advertises (in-house foundry, ASTM A216/A351/A352/A494/A995 castings), which would fall outside 8481 if sold as castings. Status: partial (correct codes, incomplete coverage). IMPORTANT IDENTITY CAVEAT: the domain oswalvalves.com resolves to 'Oswal Industries Limited' (Block No. 258, Ahmedabad-Mehsana Expressway, Kalol, Gandhinagar-382740; phone +91 22-61448000-99), not to a legal entity named 'Oswal Valves Private Limited'. No page found confirming a separate 'Oswal Valves Pvt Ltd' entity or its own catalogue - so the product mapping above is attributed to the Oswal valve business as published on that domain and is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' as regards the exact legal entity in the declaration. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'IT и электроника' is wrong - this is mechanical engineering / industrial valve manufacturing (HS 8481), not electronics. No customs line was available to me in this task, so no shipment-level corroboration of any HS code is asserted; all product claims are website-declared only. Per project rules the HS/industry mismatch is not a rejection ground - company retained, industry to be corrected to industrial valves, HS 848130/848180 confirmed with the coverage note above.
